info.name: AI Drama public API
info.description: HTTP checks against the running development API and its MySQL database. Requires public dramas with free/paid episodes and previews, plus the documented zero-balance point error fixture. Does not download signed media URLs.

exec: pm.test("API does not return a server error", () => {
if (pm.response.code === 204) pm.test('204 response body is empty', () => pm.expect(pm.response.text()).to.equal(''));
pm.test("Public response shapes and identifiers follow the API contract", () => {

const checkGenre = value => { exactKeys(value, ['id', 'code', 'name', 'tileImage']); pm.expect(value.id).to.be.a('number').and.satisfy(Number.isInteger); pm.expect(value.code).to.be.a('string'); pm.expect(value.name).to.be.a('string'); pm.expect(value.tileImage === null || typeof value.tileImage === 'string').to.equal(true); };

const checkDramaGenre = value => { exactKeys(value, ['id', 'code', 'name']); pm.expect(value.id).to.be.a('number').and.satisfy(Number.isInteger); pm.expect(value.code).to.be.a('string'); pm.expect(value.name).to.be.a('string'); };

const checkImages = value => { exactKeys(value, ['poster', 'posterLandscape', 'homeHero', 'detailCover', 'campaigns']); const validUrl = url => url === null || (typeof url === 'string' && /^https:\/\//.test(url)); ['poster', 'posterLandscape', 'homeHero', 'detailCover'].forEach(key => pm.expect(validUrl(value[key])).to.equal(true)); pm.expect(value.campaigns).to.be.an('array'); value.campaigns.forEach(url => pm.expect(url).to.match(/^https:\/\//)); };

const checkDrama = (value, kind) => { const keys = kind === 'catalog' ? ['uuid','slug','title','shortDescription','productionCompany','genres','imageUrls','previewVideos','episodeCount','freeEpisodeCount'] : kind === 'detail' ? ['uuid','slug','title','shortDescription','synopsis','productionCompany','genres','imageUrls','previewVideos','episodes'] : ['uuid','slug','title','shortDescription','productionCompany','genres','imageUrls','previewVideos','publishedEpisodeCount','freeEpisodeCount','displayOrder']; exactKeys(value, keys); pm.expect(value.uuid).to.match(uuid); ['slug','title','shortDescription'].forEach(key => pm.expect(value[key]).to.be.a('string')); if (kind === 'detail') pm.expect(value.synopsis).to.be.a('string'); if(kind === 'collection') { if(value.productionCompany !== null) { exactKeys(value.productionCompany,['uuid','name']); pm.expect(value.productionCompany.uuid).to.match(uuid); pm.expect(value.productionCompany.name).to.be.a('string'); } } else pm.expect(value.productionCompany === null || typeof value.productionCompany === 'string').to.equal(true); pm.expect(value.genres).to.be.an('array'); value.genres.forEach(checkDramaGenre); checkImages(value.imageUrls); pm.expect(value.previewVideos).to.be.an('array'); value.previewVideos.forEach(checkMedia); if(kind === 'catalog') { pm.expect(value.episodeCount).to.satisfy(Number.isInteger); pm.expect(value.freeEpisodeCount).to.satisfy(Number.isInteger); } if(kind === 'collection') { pm.expect(value.publishedEpisodeCount).to.satisfy(Number.isInteger); pm.expect(value.freeEpisodeCount).to.satisfy(Number.isInteger); pm.expect(value.displayOrder).to.satisfy(Number.isInteger); } if(kind === 'detail') { pm.expect(value.episodes).to.be.an('array'); value.episodes.forEach(episode => { exactKeys(episode,['uuid','episodeNumber','title','synopsis','durationMs','pricePoints','image','isUnlocked','videoUuid','isSaved','watchProgress']); pm.expect(episode.episodeNumber).to.satisfy(Number.isInteger); pm.expect(episode.title === null || typeof episode.title === 'string').to.equal(true); pm.expect(episode.synopsis === null || typeof episode.synopsis === 'string').to.equal(true); pm.expect(episode.durationMs).to.satisfy(Number.isInteger); pm.expect(episode.pricePoints).to.satisfy(Number.isInteger); pm.expect(episode.image === null || typeof episode.image === 'string').to.equal(true); pm.expect(episode.isUnlocked).to.be.a('boolean'); pm.expect(episode.videoUuid === null || typeof episode.videoUuid === 'string').to.equal(true); pm.expect(episode.isSaved).to.be.a('boolean'); if(episode.watchProgress !== null) { exactKeys(episode.watchProgress,['positionMs','isCompleted','lastPlayedAt']); pm.expect(episode.watchProgress.positionMs).to.satisfy(Number.isInteger); pm.expect(episode.watchProgress.isCompleted).to.be.a('boolean'); pm.expect(episode.watchProgress.lastPlayedAt).to.be.a('string'); } }); } };

const checkResponseRoot = (name, value) => { if(name === 'Genres') { pm.expect(value).to.be.an('array'); value.forEach(checkGenre); } else if(name === 'Latest dramas') { pm.expect(value).to.be.an('array'); value.forEach(item => checkDrama(item,'catalog')); if(value.length) { const sample=value[0]; const omitted={...sample}; delete omitted.slug; const noNullable={...sample}; delete noNullable.productionCompany; pm.expect(()=>checkDrama({...sample,data:sample},'catalog')).to.throw(); pm.expect(()=>checkDrama(omitted,'catalog')).to.throw(); pm.expect(()=>checkDrama({...sample,episodeCount:String(sample.episodeCount)},'catalog')).to.throw(); pm.expect(()=>checkDrama(noNullable,'catalog')).to.throw(); pm.expect(()=>checkResponseRoot(name,{data:value})).to.throw();  } } else if(name.startsWith('Drama detail')) { checkDrama(value,'detail'); const assertEpisodeOrder=episodes=>{const numbers=episodes.map(episode=>episode.episodeNumber);pm.expect(numbers).to.eql(numbers.slice().sort((a,b)=>a-b));}; assertEpisodeOrder(value.episodes); if(value.episodes.length>1) pm.expect(()=>assertEpisodeOrder(value.episodes.slice().reverse())).to.throw(); } else if(name.startsWith('Collection ')) { exactKeys(value,['code','title','description','dramas']); pm.expect(value.title).to.be.a('string'); pm.expect(value.description === null || typeof value.description === 'string').to.equal(true); pm.expect(value.dramas).to.be.an('array'); value.dramas.forEach(item => checkDrama(item,'collection')); } else if(name.toLowerCase().includes('playback') && pm.response.code === 200 ) { exactKeys(value, name.startsWith('Preview') ? ['url','videoUuid','isSaved','durationMs'] : ['url','videoUuid','isSaved','title','episodeNumber','durationMs']); pm.expect(value.url).to.match(/^https:\/\//); pm.expect(value.videoUuid).to.match(uuid); pm.expect(value.isSaved).to.be.a('boolean'); pm.expect(value.durationMs).to.satisfy(Number.isInteger); if('episodeNumber' in value) { pm.expect(value.title === null || typeof value.title === 'string').to.equal(true); pm.expect(value.episodeNumber).to.satisfy(Number.isInteger); } } else if(name.includes('Login') || name.includes('Refresh chain') || name.includes('rotation receives')) { exactKeys(value,['uuid','displayName','accountType','availablePoints','accessToken','refreshToken','expiresIn']); pm.expect(value.uuid).to.match(uuid); pm.expect(value.displayName === null || typeof value.displayName === 'string').to.equal(true); pm.expect(value.accountType).to.be.a('string'); pm.expect(value.availablePoints).to.satisfy(Number.isInteger); pm.expect(value.accessToken).to.be.a('string').and.not.empty; pm.expect(value.refreshToken).to.be.a('string').and.not.empty; pm.expect(value.expiresIn).to.equal(900); } else if(name.includes('Point increase succeeds') || name.includes('Point increase retry')) { exactKeys(value,['uuid','amount','balanceAfter']); pm.expect(value.amount).to.satisfy(Number.isInteger); pm.expect(value.balanceAfter).to.satisfy(Number.isInteger); } else if(name.includes('Purchase') && pm.response.code === 200) { exactKeys(value,['episodeUuid','entitlementUuid','chargedPoints','availablePoints']); pm.expect(value.entitlementUuid === null || typeof value.entitlementUuid === 'string').to.equal(true); pm.expect(value.chargedPoints).to.satisfy(Number.isInteger); pm.expect(value.availablePoints).to.satisfy(Number.isInteger); } };

if ("errorCode" in value) { exact(["errorCode", "errorName", "statusCode", "timestamp", "path"]); pm.expect(value.statusCode).to.equal(pm.response.code); pm.expect(new Date(value.timestamp).toISOString()).to.equal(value.timestamp); const requestUrl = new URL(pm.variables.replaceIn(pm.request.url.toString())); pm.expect(value.path).to.equal(requestUrl.pathname + requestUrl.search); }
if ("storageKey" in value && "isSaved" in value && "durationMs" in value) exact(["uuid", "storageKey", "durationMs", "isSaved"]);

if ("episodeNumber" in value && "pricePoints" in value) exact(["uuid", "episodeNumber", "title", "synopsis", "durationMs", "pricePoints", "image", "isUnlocked", "videoUuid", "isSaved", "watchProgress"]);
if ("code" in value && "dramas" in value) exact(["code", "title", "description", "dramas"]);

if ("videoUuid" in value && "contentType" in value) exact(["videoUuid", "contentType", "savedAt", "dramaUuid", "dramaTitle", "imageUrl", "durationMs", "episodeUuid", "episodeNumber", "episodeTitle"]);
if ("items" in value && "hasNext" in value) exact(["items", "page", "hasNext"]);
if (pm.response.code === 200) checkResponseRoot(pm.info.requestName, pm.info.requestName === 'Latest dramas' ? pm.response.json().items : pm.response.json());

pm.test('Entitled fixture login uses environment credentials and matches the existing UUID', () => { const body = pm.response.json(); pm.response.to.have.status(200); pm.expect(body.uuid).to.equal(pm.variables.get('entitledUserUuid')); pm.expect(body.accessToken).to.be.a('string').and.not.empty; pm.collectionVariables.set('entitledAccessToken', body.accessToken); pm.collectionVariables.set('entitledRefreshToken', body.refreshToken); });

pm.test('Unentitled fixture login uses environment credentials and matches the existing UUID', () => { const body = pm.response.json(); pm.response.to.have.status(200); pm.expect(body.uuid).to.equal(pm.variables.get('unentitledUserUuid')); pm.expect(body.accessToken).to.be.a('string').and.not.empty; pm.collectionVariables.set('unentitledAccessToken', body.accessToken); pm.collectionVariables.set('unentitledRefreshToken', body.refreshToken); });
pm.test("Genres contain database records with unique numeric IDs", () => {
const base = pm.variables.replaceIn('{{baseUrl}}').replace(/\/+$/, ''); const first = pm.response.json(); const dramas = []; const seen = new Set();
const requestPage = page => new Promise((resolve, reject) => pm.sendRequest({url:base+'/dramas?sort=latest&page='+page,method:'GET'},(error,response)=>error?reject(error):resolve(response)));

(async () => { let response; let page=1; while(true) { if(page===1) pm.response.to.have.status(200); else pm.expect(response.code).to.equal(200); const data=page===1?first:response.json(); validatePage(data,page); data.items.forEach(item=>{pm.expect(seen.has(item.uuid)).to.equal(false);seen.add(item.uuid);dramas.push(item);}); if(!data.hasNext) break; page+=1; response=await requestPage(page); } pm.test('Catalog has distinct dramas for playback and ownership checks',()=>{pm.expect(dramas.length).to.be.at.least(2);}); const selected=dramas.find(drama=>drama.previewVideos.length>0&&drama.freeEpisodeCount>0&&drama.episodeCount>drama.freeEpisodeCount); pm.test('Database has a drama with a preview, free episode, and paid episode',()=>pm.expect(selected,'Prepare existing development data before running API tests').to.exist); pm.collectionVariables.set('catalog',JSON.stringify(dramas)); if(selected){pm.collectionVariables.set('selectedDrama',JSON.stringify(selected));pm.collectionVariables.set('dramaId',selected.uuid);pm.collectionVariables.set('previewId',selected.previewVideos[0].uuid);const other=dramas.find(drama=>drama.uuid!==selected.uuid);if(other)pm.collectionVariables.set('otherDramaId',other.uuid);}else pm.execution.setNextRequest(null); })().catch(error=>pm.test('Catalog pagination follow-up requests succeed',()=>{throw error;}));
pm.test("Public episode counts, ordering, and prices agree with the catalog", () => {
pm.test("Detail supplies both playback test cases", () => {

item.name: Write and verify episode watch progress

exec: const validate = (method,url,response) => { const parsed=new URL(url); const path=parsed.pathname+parsed.search; if(response.code===204) { pm.expect(response.text()).to.equal(''); return; } if(!/application\/json/i.test(response.headers.get('Content-Type')||'')) return; const body=response.json(); const keys=(value,expected)=>pm.expect(Object.keys(value).sort()).to.eql(expected.slice().sort()); if(body&&typeof body==='object'&&!Array.isArray(body)){ pm.expect(body).not.to.have.property('data'); if(response.code>=400){ keys(body,['errorCode','errorName','statusCode','timestamp','path']); pm.expect(body.statusCode).to.equal(response.code); pm.expect(new Date(body.timestamp).toISOString()).to.equal(body.timestamp); pm.expect(body.path).to.equal(path); } else if(response.code===200&&path.startsWith('/episodes/')&&path.endsWith('/playback')){ keys(body,['url','videoUuid','isSaved','title','episodeNumber','durationMs']); pm.expect(body.url).to.match(/^https:\/\//); pm.expect(body.videoUuid).to.match(/^[0-9a-f-]{36}$/i); pm.expect(body.isSaved).to.be.a('boolean'); pm.expect(body.title===null||typeof body.title==='string').to.equal(true); pm.expect(body.episodeNumber).to.satisfy(Number.isInteger); pm.expect(body.durationMs).to.satisfy(Number.isInteger); } else if(response.code===200&&/^\/dramas\/[^/]+$/.test(parsed.pathname)){ keys(body,['uuid','slug','title','shortDescription','synopsis','productionCompany','genres','imageUrls','previewVideos','episodes']); pm.expect(body.productionCompany===null||typeof body.productionCompany==='string').to.equal(true); keys(body.imageUrls,['poster','posterLandscape','homeHero','detailCover','campaigns']); body.genres.forEach(item=>keys(item,['id','code','name'])); body.previewVideos.forEach(item=>keys(item,['uuid','storageKey','durationMs','isSaved'])); body.episodes.forEach(item=>{ keys(item,['uuid','episodeNumber','title','synopsis','durationMs','pricePoints','image','isUnlocked','videoUuid','isSaved','watchProgress']); if(item.watchProgress!==null)keys(item.watchProgress,['positionMs','isCompleted','lastPlayedAt']); }); } } }; const send = (method, url, token, body) => new Promise((resolve, reject) => pm.sendRequest({ url, method, header: Object.assign({ 'Content-Type': 'application/json' }, token ? { Authorization: 'Bearer ' + token } : {}), body: body === undefined ? undefined : { mode: 'raw', raw: JSON.stringify(body) } }, (error, response) => { if(error)return reject(error); validate(method,url,response); resolve(response); }));

const base = pm.variables.replaceIn('{{baseUrl}}'); const freeEpisode = pm.collectionVariables.get('freeEpisodeId'); const dramaUrl = base + '/dramas/' + pm.collectionVariables.get('dramaId'); const unentitled = pm.collectionVariables.get('unentitledAccessToken'); const entitled = pm.collectionVariables.get('entitledAccessToken'); const progressUrl = video => base + '/me/videos/' + video + '/watch-progress';

const freePlayback = await send('GET', base + '/episodes/' + freeEpisode + '/playback', unentitled); pm.test('Free episode playback provides its video UUID and duration', () => { pm.expect(freePlayback.code).to.equal(200); pm.expect(freePlayback.json().videoUuid).to.match(/^[0-9a-f-]{36}$/i); pm.expect(freePlayback.json().durationMs).to.be.above(0); }); const freeVideo = freePlayback.json().videoUuid; const freeDuration = freePlayback.json().durationMs; const threshold = Math.ceil((freeDuration * 2) / 3);

const startedAt = Date.now(); const started = await send('PUT', progressUrl(freeVideo) + '?userUuid=' + pm.variables.get('entitledUserUuid'), unentitled, { event: 'STARTED', positionMs: 0, userUuid: pm.variables.get('entitledUserUuid') }); pm.test('STARTED uses the JWT user and returns 204', () => pm.expect(started.code).to.equal(204));

const detail = await send('GET', dramaUrl, unentitled); const startedVerifiedAt = Date.now(); pm.test('STARTED inserts zero incomplete progress with a UTC timestamp from this request', () => { pm.expect(detail.code).to.equal(200); const episode = detail.json().episodes.find(item => item.uuid === freeEpisode); pm.expect(episode.watchProgress.positionMs).to.equal(0); pm.expect(episode.watchProgress.isCompleted).to.equal(false); const lastPlayedAt = Date.parse(episode.watchProgress.lastPlayedAt); pm.expect(lastPlayedAt).to.be.at.least(startedAt - 5000); pm.expect(lastPlayedAt).to.be.at.most(startedVerifiedAt + 5000); });

const repeatStart = await send('PUT', progressUrl(freeVideo), unentitled, { event: 'STARTED', positionMs: 0 }); pm.test('Repeated STARTED remains successful', () => pm.expect(repeatStart.code).to.equal(204));

const invalidInputs = [{ event: 'OTHER', positionMs: 0 }, { event: 'STARTED', positionMs: -1 }, { event: 'STARTED', positionMs: 0.5 }, { event: 'STARTED', positionMs: 1 }, { event: 'COMPLETED', positionMs: threshold - 1 }, { event: 'COMPLETED', positionMs: freeDuration + 1 }, null];

for (const body of invalidInputs) { const response = await send('PUT', progressUrl(freeVideo), unentitled, body); pm.test('Invalid watch-progress input returns 400', () => pm.expect(response.code).to.equal(400)); } const invalidUuid = await send('PUT', progressUrl('not-a-uuid'), unentitled, { event: 'STARTED', positionMs: 0 }); pm.test('Invalid video UUID returns 400', () => pm.expect(invalidUuid.code).to.equal(400));

const anonymous = await send('PUT', progressUrl(freeEpisode), null, { event: 'STARTED', positionMs: 0 }); pm.test('Watch progress requires authentication', () => { pm.expect(anonymous.code).to.equal(401); pm.expect(anonymous.json().errorCode).to.equal('AUTH_INVALID_TOKEN'); }); const invalidToken = await send('PUT', progressUrl(freeEpisode), 'invalid-token', { event: 'STARTED', positionMs: 0 }); pm.test('Invalid Access JWT returns the existing 401 error', () => { pm.expect(invalidToken.code).to.equal(401); pm.expect(invalidToken.json().errorCode).to.equal('AUTH_INVALID_TOKEN'); });

const missing = await send('PUT', progressUrl(pm.collectionVariables.get('missingId')), unentitled, { event: 'STARTED', positionMs: 0 }); pm.test('Missing video returns 404', () => pm.expect(missing.code).to.equal(404)); const oldRoute = await send('PUT', base + '/me/episodes/' + freeEpisode + '/watch-progress', unentitled, { event: 'STARTED', positionMs: 0 }); pm.test('Removed episode route returns 404', () => pm.expect(oldRoute.code).to.equal(404));

const lockedEpisode = detail.json().episodes.find(item => item.uuid === pm.variables.get('lockedEpisodeUuid')); const denied = await send('PUT', progressUrl(lockedEpisode.videoUuid), unentitled, { event: 'STARTED', positionMs: 0 }); pm.test('Unpurchased paid episode returns the existing 403 error', () => { pm.expect(lockedEpisode.videoUuid).to.match(/^[0-9a-f-]{36}$/i); pm.expect(denied.code).to.equal(403); pm.expect(denied.json().errorCode).to.equal('EPISODE_ACCESS_DENIED'); });

const completedAt = Date.now(); const complete = await send('PUT', progressUrl(freeVideo), unentitled, { event: 'COMPLETED', positionMs: threshold }); pm.test('Two-thirds boundary saves completion', () => pm.expect(complete.code).to.equal(204)); const completedDetail = await send('GET', dramaUrl, unentitled); const completedVerifiedAt = Date.now(); pm.test('COMPLETED update returns a UTC timestamp from this request', () => { pm.expect(completedDetail.code).to.equal(200); const episode = completedDetail.json().episodes.find(item => item.uuid === freeEpisode); const lastPlayedAt = Date.parse(episode.watchProgress.lastPlayedAt); pm.expect(lastPlayedAt).to.be.at.least(completedAt - 5000); pm.expect(lastPlayedAt).to.be.at.most(completedVerifiedAt + 5000); });

const laterStart = await send('PUT', progressUrl(freeVideo), unentitled, { event: 'STARTED', positionMs: 0 }); pm.test('Later STARTED cannot clear completion', () => pm.expect(laterStart.code).to.equal(204));

const concurrent = await Promise.all([send('PUT', progressUrl(freeVideo), unentitled, { event: 'STARTED', positionMs: 0 }), send('PUT', progressUrl(freeVideo), unentitled, { event: 'COMPLETED', positionMs: threshold })]); pm.test('Concurrent start and completion both succeed', () => concurrent.forEach(response => pm.expect(response.code).to.equal(204)));

const finalDetail = await send('GET', dramaUrl, unentitled); pm.test('Completion position is retained and another user and anonymous see null', async () => { const episode = finalDetail.json().episodes.find(item => item.uuid === freeEpisode); pm.expect(episode.watchProgress.isCompleted).to.equal(true); pm.expect(episode.watchProgress.positionMs).to.equal(threshold); const other = await send('GET', dramaUrl, entitled); pm.expect(other.json().episodes.find(item => item.uuid === freeEpisode).watchProgress).to.equal(null); const publicDetail = await send('GET', dramaUrl); pm.expect(publicDetail.json().episodes.find(item => item.uuid === freeEpisode).watchProgress).to.equal(null); });

const paidPlayback = await send('GET', base + '/episodes/' + pm.variables.get('entitledEpisodeUuid') + '/playback', entitled); const paidStart = await send('PUT', progressUrl(paidPlayback.json().videoUuid), entitled, { event: 'STARTED', positionMs: 0 }); pm.test('Purchased paid episode accepts progress by video UUID', () => pm.expect(paidStart.code).to.equal(204));
})().catch(error => pm.test('Watch progress HTTP scenarios complete', () => { throw error; }));
